description: This PHP source file defines a function getAttachmentsList() that retrieves and displays a list of Word document templates stored in the vtiger_wordtemplates database table. The function constructs an HTML table listing template details, including filename, module, description, type, and download links.

methods.name: getAttachmentsList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Word template attachments from the database and generates an HTML table listing their details and download links.
